boundary: durable failures only: operational failures (env/data/rate limit) belong in run logs. Each entry must be reproducible from its evidence; this atlas is memory, not a claim.

entries.observed: literature synthesize failed with 'requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY or an injected model port' while a gateway profile was configured and every other stage used it
entries.diagnosis: the synthesis stage constructed its own DeepSeek client instead of using the shared gateway resolver; two supply paths for one capability
entries.retry_condition: re-run only after grep shows no new generation stage reading provider env vars directly; regression test test_default_model_prefers_gateway_binding
evidence: design/87-阶段级压力测试第二轮-S1b与评审链的网关断点.md §2

entries.observed: paper.json said writer_mode=deterministic while stderr showed a model profile was resolved; no warning was recorded
entries.diagnosis: a section writer returning None (model error or JSON failure) fell through to the deterministic draft without leaving a trace; failures must be visible in the artifact
entries.retry_condition: any new model-backed stage must record model_failed plus a reason; covered by tests/test_pipeline.py::test_silent_writer_failure_is_reported_not_hidden
evidence: design/86-真实模型跑通各阶段后的反思.md §3 F5

entries.observed: primary_metric was a full sentence and budget was 'Not specified…' yet design-audit reported design.required=pass
entries.diagnosis: structural validation checked non-emptiness only; a field can be filled and still be unexecutable by S5
entries.retry_condition: add shape checks whenever a new model-drafted field is introduced; currently metric/budget shape warnings (design/86 F3), promotion to a G2 blocker needs human confirmation
evidence: design/86-真实模型跑通各阶段后的反思.md §2.3、§3 F3

entries.observed: a candidate whose falsification said 'the same model rankings and performance gaps persist' was labelled needs_metric
entries.diagnosis: the metric-signal vocabulary lacked comparison words (ranking/gap/outperform); the checker was right in spirit and wrong in vocabulary
entries.retry_condition: extend vocabulary with a test per new word; lexicon remains a pre-review, not a quality judgement
evidence: design/86-真实模型跑通各阶段后的反思.md §3 F4

entries.observed: innovation stage label kept showing 'X / 06' after the seven-act page was extended; the static HTML said 01/07 but JS overwrote it
entries.diagnosis: derived numbers (act count, totals) were hardcoded in two places; fixing the static copy did not fix the script
entries.retry_condition: every counter must derive from its data source (ACTS.length) and be verified in a real browser, not by reading the HTML
evidence: design/91-演示主线前移-先问度量与判定.md §1

entries.observed: --idea-model deepseek-v41 printed 'unknown idea model; using rule-based candidates' and exited 0
entries.diagnosis: three model options required a 'profile:' prefix while a bare id is the natural spelling; unknown ids degraded silently instead of failing or being accepted
entries.retry_condition: any new model option must accept a bare id when the gateway declares it and must surface the reason in the result, not only stderr; covered by tests/test_model_profile_resolution.py
evidence: design/86-真实模型跑通各阶段后的反思.md §3 F1
